set(FLD_SHARE ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR})

install(FILES wayland-sessions/fldesktop.desktop DESTINATION ${FLD_SHARE}/wayland-sessions)
file(GLOB _apps applications/*.desktop)
install(FILES ${_apps} DESTINATION ${FLD_SHARE}/applications)
# hicolor holds the application icons; the fldesktop* themes (icons, accent
# variants, monochrome, cursors) are generated by tools/artwork/build.sh
install(DIRECTORY icons/hicolor DESTINATION ${FLD_SHARE}/icons)
file(GLOB _themes LIST_DIRECTORIES true ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/icons/fldesktop*)
option(FLD_INSTALL_ARTWORK "Install the fldesktop icon and cursor themes" ON)
if(FLD_INSTALL_ARTWORK)
  install(DIRECTORY ${_themes} DESTINATION ${FLD_SHARE}/icons)
endif()
file(GLOB _backgrounds backgrounds/*.svg)
install(FILES ${_backgrounds} DESTINATION ${FLD_SHARE}/fldesktop/backgrounds)
install(FILES charmap/Blocks.txt charmap/LICENSE.unicode DESTINATION ${FLD_SHARE}/fldesktop/charmap)
# greetd's example config: the greeter user and VT differ between distributions
# (Arch: greeter, VT 1; Debian: _greetd, VT 7, the VT its greetd.service takes).
set(FLD_GREETD_USER "greeter" CACHE STRING "User greetd runs the greeter as")
set(FLD_GREETD_VT "1" CACHE STRING "VT greetd runs on")
configure_file(greetd/config.toml.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/greetd/config.toml @ONLY)
install(FILES wm.ini.example greeter.ini.example ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/greetd/config.toml DESTINATION ${FLD_SHARE}/fldesktop)
install(FILES autostart/fl-polkit-agent.desktop DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_SYSCONFDIR}/xdg/autostart)

# Mirror the data into the build tree so programs can run uninstalled:
#   XDG_DATA_DIRS=build/share:/usr/share FLD_DATADIR=build/share/fldesktop
set(_out ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/share)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${_out}/applications ${_out}/fldesktop/backgrounds ${_out}/wayland-sessions)
file(COPY ${_apps} DESTINATION ${_out}/applications)
file(COPY icons/hicolor ${_themes} DESTINATION ${_out}/icons)
file(COPY ${_backgrounds} DESTINATION ${_out}/fldesktop/backgrounds)
file(COPY charmap/Blocks.txt DESTINATION ${_out}/fldesktop/charmap)
file(COPY wm.ini.example DESTINATION ${_out}/fldesktop)
file(COPY wayland-sessions/fldesktop.desktop DESTINATION ${_out}/wayland-sessions)

file(GLOB _man ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/doc/man/*.1)
install(FILES ${_man} DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_MANDIR}/man1)

# the Plymouth boot splash (fldesktop-plymouth-theme); the images are made by
# tools/artwork/plymouth.py
option(FLD_INSTALL_PLYMOUTH "Install the fldesktop Plymouth boot splash theme" ON)
if(FLD_INSTALL_PLYMOUTH)
  install(DIRECTORY plymouth/fldesktop DESTINATION ${FLD_SHARE}/plymouth/themes)
endif()
